extracted.summary: A private client solicitor administering a £1.341m Guildford estate, largely illiquid property, enquires about borrowing around £189,000 to cover inheritance tax and legal fees pending the grant of probate.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding for the administration of this estate. We have noted the approximate gross estate value of £1,341,000, that it consists largely of the deceased's property, and the requested amount of around £189,000 for IHT and fees. To take this further we would need confirmation of the executors' details and their consent, a breakdown of estate assets and liabilities, the IHT position and any payment deadline, details of any existing charges over the property, and confirmation of the stage reached in the probate application. Once we have those we will review the enquiry and come back to you.
